topLevel.why: X preserves the separate Preface and Notation divisions and ends Historic Perspective before the back matter. Y merges those front-matter divisions and absorbs acknowledgements and bibliography into the history chapter; neither tree cuts a substantive chapter midway.

gists.why: X more often identifies the specific material a reader would encounter, particularly parallel transport, manifold Fourier analysis, data augmentation, time warping, and EHR patient graphs. Y's broader summaries are generally compatible with their sections but provide less guidance for these passages.

weldedParts.why: Combines the completed preface with the separately headed symbol-reference table.
Combines the history chapter with the subsequent acknowledgements and bibliography.
Groups the separately headed acknowledgements and bibliography into one back-matter part, although its title makes that grouping explicit.

overall.why: X follows the document's major divisions more faithfully and offers more targeted section gists for the sampled material. Its explicit back-matter grouping is easier to navigate than Y's inclusion of that material under Historic Perspective.
